title: Station state answer with the node fields
description: Designed (docs/nodes.md 2.2 and 5 "Wire contract"), not implemented. Today's state answer (station-state-answer.schema.json) plus the optional keys the hub adds for a node: the other halves of the resync and the leases the node holds. Every new key is optional, so every answer a hub sends today is valid here, and a station from before this ignores them.

capabilities_wanted.description: True when the hub does not hold the capabilities with the `capabilities_rev` of this post: the node sends `capabilities` in full on its next post. Absent or false: the hub has them.

roles_rev.description: The content hash of this node's roles as the hub holds them. The node echoes the one it applied as `roles_applied`.

leases.description: The exactly-one roles this node holds now, one lease each. Sent on every answer while held (each answer renews). A node that finds no lease for a role here does not start that role's work, and stops it when the last one it received runs out.
